name: Silvia Ferrari
title: Professor; Director, Laboratory for Intelligent Systems and Controls; Associate Dean for Cross-Campus Engineering Research
department: Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering; Computer Science graduate field (current directory header discrepancy noted)
fitReason: Strong multi-agent physical AI fit through onboard learned visual recognition, probabilistic state estimation and information-driven planning. The demonstrated assignment/control algorithm is optimization-based, not an RL motor policy.

physicalEvidence.summary: June 10, 2026 primary article validates two Husarion ROSBots tracking three human targets in 20 trials. Onboard R-CNN detects people and Re-ID Net associates known target identities from reference images; RGB-D sensing, Kalman filtering, adaptive target assignment and information-gain control drive the robots. Intel Atom processors and WiFi are named. Physical execution uses one assignment/control iteration per step; repeated iterations occur only in simulation. Contributions explicitly identify Ferrari as PI and Cornell researchers as the physical-experiment team.

name: Pingping Zhu
title: Associate Professor; Principal Investigator, Perception Intelligence Networks Group
department: Biomedical and Electrical Engineering; Computer Science
fitReason: Concrete local ML-perception-to-flight integration and active collaborative multi-robot research. Current hardware evidence centers on perception/interaction integration and planning, not newly trained end-to-end RL.

physicalEvidence.summary: May/June 2025 primary study physically tests a Crazyflie2.1 with Flow Deck V2, Multi-Ranger and AI-Deck at Marshall. MediaPipe learned hand landmarks run on a ground laptop; geometric gesture rules map them to flight commands. Range-threshold avoidance is hand-coded and video streams from the drone, so the method is not an onboard learned flight policy. Zhu is credited for supervision, resources and project administration. Separately, the June 2026 Cornell-led ROSBot paper is collaborative hardware and does not establish Marshall ownership of those ground robots.

shortVisit.summary: Current PiNG joining page advertises PhD and MS research assistant positions; MS funding language is ordinary degree recruitment, not an explicit external short visit. The undergraduate section lists US citizenship. That scoped undergraduate condition is not generalized to graduate students or all lab projects. Team roster names current MS/PhD advisees and the Crazyflie study’s first author.
